name: Event Planner

sections.daily_work: Plan and coordinate events from concept to execution. Manage budgets, vendors, and timelines. Handle logistics like venue, catering, and AV. Solve on-site problems.
sections.learning: Project management, budgeting, vendor negotiation, contract management, event design, logistics planning, marketing and promotion, crisis management.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $35,000-$50,000 USD. Mid-level $50,000-$75,000. Senior planners and directors can earn $80,000-$120,000. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Hospitality or communications degree, event planning certificate (CMP, CSEP), volunteering at events, internship at an event agency, starting as an event assistant.

try_in_real_life: Plan a detailed event: birthday party, fundraiser, or club meeting
Create a timeline, budget, and checklist for a real event
Volunteer at a conference or festival to see backstage logistics
Research the Certified Meeting Professional (CMP) credential
sources: Events Industry Council salary surveys; BLS meeting and event planners data
